literal.prompt: Какая приключенческая игра 1993 года предлагает исследовать остров Myst и переходить в другие миры через книги?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Cyan primary page states that books are portals to fantastical places and secret books on Myst island lead to worlds; it identifies the original release as 1993 (L35-L46, L91-L94). The key Myst is directly supported. The three distractors are genre-mismatched: StarCraft is a strategy, Diablo an action RPG, Metal Gear Solid stealth; they are readily eliminated rather than comparable adventure/puzzle alternatives.
literalGroups.locator: Cyan L35-L46, L91-L94; Blizzard L2-L6; Konami L40-L47.

literalGroups.literal: В 1993 году Myst стала самой продаваемой компьютерной игрой на CD-ROM. Правильный ответ — Myst.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Cyan states Myst was released in September 1993 and became the best-selling PC game of all time; The Strong specifically calls it the best-selling CD-ROM computer game of 1993 (Cyan L91-L94; The Strong L203-L205).

literalGroups.literal: Cyan создала для Myst более 2500 предварительно отрисованных изображений; карты слишком сложных сцен команда строила в StrataVision 3D.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong states Cyan used StrataVision 3D to render maps too complex to draw by hand (L208), and Cyan records 2,500 prerendered images for Myst (L93-L105). This is an additional fact beyond prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: StarCraft — игра с тремя разными расами: терранами, протоссами и зергов.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Blizzard explicitly names the three StarCraft races as Terran, Protoss and Zerg (L2-L6, L9-L39). The note is supported and useful for this option.

literalGroups.literal: Diablo — ролевая экшен-игра Blizzard с процедурными подземельями и добычей предметов.
literalGroups.primaryGround: HOLD: the note claims Diablo is an action RPG with procedural dungeons and loot. The official Diablo 4 page and the official Diablo 3 site each returned 403. No retained primary context was found for this exact claim. After the one official alternative attempt, this exact claim remains held.
literalGroups.locator: Primary https://diablo4.blizzard.com/en-us/ returned 403; official alternative https://diablo3.blizzard.com/en-us/ returned 403.

literalGroups.literal: В METAL GEAR SOLID игрок проникает во вражеские крепости и выполняет задания скрытно.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Konami describes the Metal Gear series as stealth missions infiltrating enemy fortresses (L40-L47). The revised note removes the unsupported attribution to Hideo Kojima.
